entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: August Revolution, a transformative movement in Vietnam (1940–1945). Emerged from Yen Bai mutiny — VNQDD-led uprising brutally suppressed and Ho Chi Minh founds the Indochinese Communist Party. Catalyzed Vietnamese famine kills an estimated 1–2 million people and French Return and War.
